Brother Blind

Overview

Brother Blind is a blind member of the Last Shelter and an experienced teacher. Khatul praises his extraordinary hearing and accuracy with a bow. At Khatul’s request he agrees to improve Zak’s dexterity; his own dialogue makes clear that blindness has not diminished his wit or independence. [1]

Acceptance into the Last Shelter

Beyond the caves, Brother Blacksmith finds Zak and vouches for him before Brother Khatul. The brotherhood’s leader fears imperial spies and requires the Emperor’s Signet Ring, taken from a cyclops who killed its courier. Possessing such an object compromises the newcomer with the authorities and makes the test more than a feat of strength. After Zak returns, Khatul accepts him as Brother Blondie and offers the refuge as a new home. Zak explains his promise to find At-Zako and return to Gipath. Khatul respects that purpose and asks those who can help to support him; Brother Blind can teach him greater dexterity. [2, 3, 1]
